title: The Blood Registry
summary: Ambushed in the Yeouido drains, Ha-Jun dismantles the Hunter strike team and recovers the physical Blood Registry dossier, revealing that dormant carriers across Seoul are being executed.

panels.shot: sniper rifle muzzle flare in darkness
panels.action: A silenced high-caliber sniper rifle flashes in the darkness of the overhead drainage shaft.
panels.prose_en: A silenced high-caliber sniper rifle flashes in the darkness of the overhead drainage shaft.
panels.prose_hi: Overhead drainage shaft ke andhere mein ek khamosh high-calibar sniper rifle chamakti hai.

panels.shot: depleted uranium bullet flying in slow motion
panels.action: A silver-plated tungsten round engraved with anti-mana runes spirals through the air at supersonic speed.
panels.prose_en: A silver-plated tungsten round engraved with anti-mana runes spirals through the air at supersonic speed.
panels.prose_hi: Ek silvar-plated tungsten round, jo anti-mana ke saath utkeern hai, supersonic gati se hawa ke madhyam se sarpil chalta hai.

panels.shot: bone gauntlet snapping up to intercept
panels.action: Ha-Jun's left arm blurs upward, intercepting the bullet centimeters before it strikes his chest.
panels.prose_en: Ha-Jun's left arm blurs upward, intercepting the bullet centimeters before it strikes his chest.
panels.prose_hi: Ha-Jun ka bayan haath upar ki or dhundhla ho jata hai, goli uski chhati par lagne se kuch centimeter pehle hi ruk jaati hai.

panels.shot: bullet shattering against bone plating
panels.action: The tungsten round shatters against the polished ivory bone gauntlet with an explosion of silver sparks.
panels.prose_en: The tungsten round shatters against the polished ivory bone gauntlet with an explosion of silver sparks.
panels.prose_hi: Chandi ki chingari ke visfot ke saath polish ki gai hathi daant ki haddi ke gauntlet ke khilaf tungsten ka daur toot jata hai.

panels.shot: sniper on catwalk gasping in shock
panels.action: A black-clad Hunter sniper in night-vision goggles jerks backward: 'Direct deflection?! Impossible!'

dialogue.speaker: hunter_sniper
dialogue.text: Armor-piercing round hath par lag kar toot gayi?! Target is a Monster!

panels.prose_en: A black-clad Hunter sniper in night-vision goggles jerks backward: 'Direct deflection?! Impossible!'.
panels.prose_hi: Night-vizan goggles pahane ek kale-pahne hunter sniper ne peeche ki or jhatka diya: 'pratyaksh vikshepan?! asambhav!'.

panels.shot: ha-jun flicking fingers to cast blood needles
panels.action: With a snap of his right wrist, Ha-Jun fires three razor-thin crimson blood needles upward.
panels.prose_en: With a snap of his right wrist, Ha-Jun fires three razor-thin crimson blood needles upward.
panels.prose_hi: Apni dahini kalai ke jhatke ke sath, Ha-Jun teen ustra-patli lal rang ki khoon suiyon ko upar ki or fire karta hai.

panels.shot: sniper rifle cleaved into pieces
panels.action: The blood needles slice cleanly through the sniper's rifle barrel and optics, disarming him instantly.
panels.prose_en: The blood needles slice cleanly through the sniper's rifle barrel and optics, disarming him instantly.
panels.prose_hi: Khun ki suiyan sniper ki rifle barrel aur optics ko saf-saf kaatati han, jisse wah turant nihattha ho jata hai.

panels.shot: two tactical strike operatives dropping from above
panels.action: Two heavily armored Bureau assault operatives drop down on rappelling ropes, brandishing stun batons.
panels.prose_en: Two heavily armored Bureau assault operatives drop down on rappelling ropes, brandishing stun batons.
panels.prose_hi: Do bhari bakhtarband bureau aakraman sanchalak stabdh kar dene wale dande lahrate hue rassiyon par girte han.

panels.shot: operatives wearing anti-mana exo-suits
panels.action: Matte-black armor plating humming with electric blue dampening grids designed to suppress supernatural mana.
panels.prose_en: Matte-black armor plating humming with electric blue dampening grids designed to suppress supernatural mana.
panels.prose_hi: Alaukik man ko dabane ke liye design kiye gaye electric blue dumping grid ke saath mat-black kavach plating gungunati hai.

panels.shot: first operative swinging electrified stun baton
panels.action: The operative swings a 50,000-volt high-frequency baton directly at Ha-Jun's temple.
panels.prose_en: The operative swings a 50,000-volt high-frequency baton directly at Ha-Jun's temple.
panels.prose_hi: Sanchalak Ha-Jun ke mandir par sidhe 50,000 volt ki uchch aavritti wali chhadi ghumata hai.

panels.shot: ha-jun catching baton with bare bone hand
panels.action: Ha-Jun catches the sparking electrified baton in his bare left bone gauntlet; electricity grounds harmlessly.
panels.prose_en: Ha-Jun catches the sparking electrified baton in his bare left bone gauntlet; electricity grounds harmlessly.
panels.prose_hi: Ha-Jun ne apni nangi bai haddi ke dastaane mein sparking vidyutikrit batten ko pakad liya; bijli hanirahit roop se ground hoti hai.

panels.shot: ha-jun crushing the baton to scrap
panels.action: With a flex of his fingers, the titanium-reinforced baton is crushed into twisted scrap metal.
panels.prose_en: With a flex of his fingers, the titanium-reinforced baton is crushed into twisted scrap metal.
panels.prose_hi: Apni ungaliyon ke lachilepan se, titenium-prablit batten ko kuchalkar mude hue scrap metal mein badal diya jata hai.

panels.shot: ha-jun delivering palm strike to operative chest
panels.action: Ha-Jun drives an open-palm kinetic strike into the operative's breastplate, blowing him 20 feet backward.
panels.prose_en: Ha-Jun drives an open-palm kinetic strike into the operative's breastplate, blowing him 20 feet backward.
panels.prose_hi: Ha-Jun ne sanchalak ke brestaplate mein khuli hatheli se gatij prahar kiya, jisse wah 20 feet peeche chala gaya.

panels.shot: operative crashing into water flume
panels.action: The armored operative skids across the rushing water canal, unconscious before making a splash.
panels.prose_en: The armored operative skids across the rushing water canal, unconscious before making a splash.
panels.prose_hi: Baktarband sanchalak chhintakashi karne se pehle behosh hokar, tez pani ki nahar ko paar kar jata hai.

panels.shot: second operative pulling tactical sidearm
panels.action: The second operative panics, drawing a heavy semi-automatic pistol loaded with hollow-point silver rounds.
panels.prose_en: The second operative panics, drawing a heavy semi-automatic pistol loaded with hollow-point silver rounds.
panels.prose_hi: Dusra operative ghabra gaya, khokhali-nukili chandi ki goliyon se bhari hui ek bhari ardh-swachalit pistol nikali.

panels.shot: kuro swooping down with talons
panels.action: Kuro dives from the rafters like an obsidian missile, his sharp talons slashing across the hunter's visor.
panels.prose_en: Kuro dives from the rafters like an obsidian missile, his sharp talons slashing across the hunter's visor.
panels.prose_hi: Kuro ek obsidian missile ki tarah chhat se gota lagata hai, uske tej panje shikari ke chhajje par war karte han.

panels.shot: operative dropping gun in agony
panels.action: The operative drops his pistol, clutching his shattered visor as purple smoke burns his eyes.
panels.prose_en: The operative drops his pistol, clutching his shattered visor as purple smoke burns his eyes.
panels.prose_hi: Operativ apni pistol gira deta hai aur apne toote hue chhajje ko pakad leta hai kyonki baingani dhuan uski aankhon ko jala deta hai.

panels.shot: ha-jun pinning operative to wall
panels.action: Ha-Jun steps forward, pinning the operative against the rusted pipe by his collar with terrifying ease.
panels.prose_en: Ha-Jun steps forward, pinning the operative against the rusted pipe by his collar with terrifying ease.
panels.prose_hi: Ha-Jun aage badhta hai, zang lage pipe par operative ko bhayanak sahajta se uske collar se pakad leta hai.

panels.shot: ha-jun dual-ringed eyes burning inches away
panels.action: Ha-Jun's violet irises with crimson rings burn mere inches from the operative's terrified eyes.

dialogue.speaker: hajun
dialogue.text: Khoon ki registry kahan hai? Aur Kang Tae-Jun kahan hai?

panels.prose_en: Ha-Jun's violet irises with crimson rings burn mere inches from the operative's terrified eyes.
panels.prose_hi: Ha-Jun ki lal rang ki chhallon wali baingani rang ki putli sanchalak ki bhaybhit aankhon se matra kuch inch ki doori par jalti hai.

panels.shot: operative trembling with chattering teeth
panels.action: The operative stammers, terrified: 'P-Pouch mein hai! Tactical tablet mein pura dossier hai!'

dialogue.speaker: operative
dialogue.text: Humein bas kill order mila tha! Main kuch nahi jaanta!

panels.prose_en: The operative stammers, terrified: 'P-Pouch mein hai! Tactical tablet mein pura dossier hai!'.
panels.prose_hi: Operativ bhaybhit hokar haklane laga: 'pi-pouch mein hai! tactical tablet mein pura dossier hai!'.

panels.shot: ha-jun confiscating tactical tablet
panels.action: Ha-Jun reaches into the operative's tactical vest and pulls out a ruggedized military tablet.
panels.prose_en: Ha-Jun reaches into the operative's tactical vest and pulls out a ruggedized military tablet.
panels.prose_hi: Ha-Jun operative ki samrik baniyan mein pahunchta hai aur ek majboot sainya tablet nikalta hai.

panels.shot: ha-jun rendering operative unconscious
panels.action: Ha-Jun taps a precise pressure point on the operative's neck; the man slumps instantly into deep sleep.
panels.prose_en: Ha-Jun taps a precise pressure point on the operative's neck; the man slumps instantly into deep sleep.
panels.prose_hi: Ha-Jun operative ki gardan par ek sateek dabav bindu par tap karta hai; aadmi turant gahri neend mein so jata hai.

panels.shot: min-jae running over with laptop
panels.action: Min-Jae runs over, taking the military tablet and plugging in a bypass chip.
panels.prose_en: Min-Jae runs over, taking the military tablet and plugging in a bypass chip.
panels.prose_hi: Min-je military tablet lekar aur bypass chip lagakar daudta hai.

panels.shot: tablet screen opening: the blood registry
panels.action: The title screen displays: 'REPUBLIC OF KOREA - DORMANT CARRIER EXTERMINATION REGISTRY (CONFIDENTIAL)'.
panels.prose_en: The title screen displays: 'REPUBLIC OF KOREA - DORMANT CARRIER EXTERMINATION REGISTRY (CONFIDENTIAL)'.
panels.prose_hi: Shirshak screen pradarshit karti hai: 'koriya ganrajya - nishkriya vahak unmulan registry (gopniy)'.

panels.shot: hundreds of citizen profiles with red crosses
panels.action: Scrolling lists of high school students, office workers, and children—each marked with a red 'PURGED' stamp.

dialogue.text: Har woh insaan jiske DNA mein ancient mana trace tha... unhe chup-chaap khatam kiya ja raha tha.

panels.prose_en: Scrolling lists of high school students, office workers, and children—each marked with a red 'PURGED' stamp.
panels.prose_hi: High school ke chhatron, karyalay karmchariyon aur bachchon ki scrolling suchiyan - pratyek ko lal 'parged' stamp se chinhit kiya gaya hai.

panels.shot: min-jae covering his mouth in horror
panels.action: Min-Jae's eyes fill with tears of horror: 'Yeh Demon hunting nahi hai... Yeh toh genocide hai!'

dialogue.speaker: min-jae
dialogue.text: Unhone innocent logon ko maar diya bas is dar se ki woh awaken ho jayenge?!

panels.prose_en: Min-Jae's eyes fill with tears of horror: 'Yeh Demon hunting nahi hai... Yeh toh genocide hai!'.
panels.prose_hi: Min-je ki aankhen bhay se bhar aati han: 'ye rakshas shikar nahin hai... yeh to narsanhar hai!'

panels.shot: ha-jun staring at the list with icy calm
panels.action: Ha-Jun's expression turns into a mask of pure, absolute imperial coldness.
panels.prose_en: Ha-Jun's expression turns into a mask of pure, absolute imperial coldness.
panels.prose_hi: Ha-Jun ki abhivyakti shuddh, purna shahi sheetalta ke mukhaute mein badal jaati hai.

panels.shot: kuro looking at ha-jun chest brand
panels.action: Kuro notes: 'Jab power insaan ke haath aati hai, toh woh Demons se bhi zyada cruel ban jaate hain.'

dialogue.speaker: kuro
dialogue.text: Ab samajh aaya tumhe tumhare bloodline ka maksad? Balance restore karna.

panels.prose_en: Kuro notes: 'Jab power insaan ke haath aati hai, toh woh Demons se bhi zyada cruel ban jaate hain.'.
panels.prose_hi: Kuro note karta hai: 'jab satta insaan ke haath aati hai, to woh rakshason se bhi jyada krur ban jaate han.'

panels.shot: ha-jun crushing the operative tablet frame
panels.action: Ha-Jun downloads the file to Min-Jae's encrypted cloud, then snaps the tablet in half with one hand.
panels.prose_en: Ha-Jun downloads the file to Min-Jae's encrypted cloud, then snaps the tablet in half with one hand.
panels.prose_hi: Ha-Jun file ko min-je ke encrypted cloud par download karta hai, phir ek haath se tablet ko aadhe mein snap karta hai.

panels.shot: ha-jun turning toward the sewer exit
panels.action: Silhouetted against the rainy city streetlights above: 'Hunter Bureau ka har criminal apna hisaab dega.'

dialogue.speaker: hajun
dialogue.text: Chalo, Min-Jae. Bureau Headquarters chalte hain.

panels.prose_en: Silhouetted against the rainy city streetlights above: 'Hunter Bureau ka har criminal apna hisaab dega.'.
panels.prose_hi: Upar barsati shahar ki stretlits ke samne chhayachitra: 'hunter bureau ka har apradhi apna hisab dega.'
